Name: Beehouses Water Surrounding Flowers and Crops
Author: Ktrlly
Description:
Beehouses will water surrounding flowers/ crops nightly while still collecting honey! Beehouses now act as a sprinkler and water the surrounding tilled tiles, so you don't have to water daily or use retaining soil <3 Works with garden pots as well, and still produces honey indoors and outdoors!

-Compatible with all major mods (I have >300 mods and it works perfectly!)
-To use: unzip the folder and place it into the mods folder!

Manifest.Name: Bee House Sprinkler
Manifest.Description: Bee Houses act like quality sprinklers.
